depicted_variant: Satu humanoid berkepala balon besar dari legenda hutan malam, menerobos semak untuk mengejar orang.

visual_requirements.description: Humanoid satu kepala sangat besar seperti balon, dua mata, dua lengan, dua kaki; pakaian penuh buram.
Mengejar manusia; tidak menambahkan kekuatan supernatural.

aura: Ancaman berasal dari siluet berkepala besar dan pengejaran hutan malam (c01/c12/c17) (klaim: melon-heads-c12, melon-heads-c17).
artistic_choices: Figur fiksi humanoid dewasa tanpa identitas anak atau visual diagnosis medis; tidak menampilkan korban, fasilitas kesehatan, atau asal medis legenda.
Pakaian penuh lusuh, palet cokelat gelap dan cahaya bulan, framing dekat merupakan pilihan editorial.
Tanpa efek kekuatan karena riset tidak memuat kuasa supernatural.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of MELON HEADS, a fictional large-headed humanoid of American nocturnal woodland folklore.
ANATOMY: one fictional adult humanoid, an enormous balloon-shaped head wider than the shoulders, two eyes, one nose and mouth, two arms and two legs, fully dressed in opaque weathered dark clothes. No medical imagery, no depiction of a real person or medical patient; no children. [melon-heads-c01, melon-heads-c17]
MOMENT: bursting out from concealing brambles and lunging toward the viewer in a terrifying pursuit, torso leaning forward, one hand reaching past snapped twigs, the enlarged head dominating the image with a sharp hostile stare.
POWER: no documented supernatural power; menace through oversized fictional head, rushing movement, and shadows only; leaves scatter from physical movement. [melon-heads-c12, melon-heads-c17]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low-angle intimate close framing, ordinary adult body scale, enlarged head clearly readable at thumbnail size; no giant body.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one cold moonbeam striking the bulging forehead and reaching hand, deep walnut-black forest shadows and ordinary haze.
SURFACE: tactile weathered opaque cloth, rough tree bark, damp leaves, expressive painterly skin.
SETTING: a forest at night; twisted branches frame the creature. [melon-heads-c17]
MOOD: dangerous, predatory, imposing, never cute, calm or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: square 1024px or larger; no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from films, games, anime or comics; no nudity, explicit gore, victims or medical diagnosis; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: PNG asli dilihat: satu kepala balon besar, dua mata dan dua tangan terbaca; lengan dan kaki tidak berlebih, figur menerobos semak dengan jangkauan konfrontatif. Seluruh tujuh Uji Sangar ya. Ancaman tetap jelas pada thumbnail. Tidak ada efek supernatural, teks, bingkai atau desain adaptasi. Kontak thumbnail asli berukuran200 piksel dilihat ulang bersama13 PNG lane-A; ciri subjek dan kesan sangar/agung tetap terbaca.

root_visual_review.notes: Humanoid with a huge bulbous head and two glaring eyes reaching through night brambles toward the viewer; clothed, two arms.
